{
  "candidate_rtl": "module addr_calcu(
    input [7:0] address,
    input [7:0] ptr1, ptr2,
    input [7:0] b,
    input control,
    output [15:0] count
);
    parameter [7:0] base = 8'b10000000;

    generate
        if (base == 8'h80) begin : optimized_base128
            wire [9:0] result1, result2;
            wire [9:0] selected;

            addr_calcu_base128_path path1 (
                .address(address), .b(b), .ptr(ptr1), .result(result1)
            );
            addr_calcu_base128_path path2 (
                .address(address), .b(b), .ptr(ptr2), .result(result2)
            );

            assign selected = (control == 1'b1) ? result1 : result2;
            assign count = {{6{selected[9]}}, selected};
        end else begin : other_bases
            wire [7:0] offset1, offset2;
            wire [15:0] addr1, addr2;
            wire [15:0] count1, count2;

            assign offset1 = base - ptr1;
            assign offset2 = base - ptr2;
            assign addr1 = address - {8'h00, offset1};
            assign addr2 = address - {8'h00, offset2};
            assign count1 = addr1 + b;
            assign count2 = addr2 + b;
            assign count = (control == 1'b1) ? count1 : count2;
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module addr_calcu_base128_path(
    input [7:0] address,
    input [7:0] b,
    input [7:0] ptr,
    output [9:0] result
);
    wire [7:0] adjusted_ptr;
    wire [7:0] sum_bits, majority_bits, shifted_carry;
    wire [7:0] propagate, generate_bits;
    wire [7:0] propagate1, propagate2;
    wire [7:0] generate1, generate2, generate4;
    wire [7:0] carries;
    wire nonzero_offset;
    wire carry8;

    assign adjusted_ptr = ptr ^ 8'h80;

    // Carry-save compression of three unsigned eight-bit operands.
    assign sum_bits = address ^ b ^ adjusted_ptr;
    assign majority_bits = (address & b) |
                           ((address ^ b) & adjusted_ptr);
    assign shifted_carry = {majority_bits[6:0], 1'b0};

    // Parallel-prefix carry computation for the low eight result bits.
    assign propagate = sum_bits ^ shifted_carry;
    assign generate_bits = sum_bits & shifted_carry;

    assign generate1 = generate_bits |
                       (propagate & {generate_bits[6:0], 1'b0});
    assign propagate1 = propagate & {propagate[6:0], 1'b0};
    assign generate2 = generate1 |
                       (propagate1 & {generate1[5:0], 2'b00});
    assign propagate2 = propagate1 & {propagate1[5:0], 2'b00};
    assign generate4 = generate2 |
                       (propagate2 & {generate2[3:0], 4'b0000});

    assign carries = {generate4[6:0], 1'b0};
    assign carry8 = generate4[7];
    assign nonzero_offset = (ptr != 8'h80);

    assign result[7:0] = propagate ^ carries;
    assign result[8] = majority_bits[7] ^ carry8 ^ nonzero_offset;
    assign result[9] = nonzero_offset & ~(majority_bits[7] | carry8);
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical path starts at control and traverses substantial arithmetic logic before reaching the upper count bits. The original expression also exposes cascaded offset subtraction, address subtraction, and addition.",
  "rewrite": "For base=128, let q=ptr XOR 128 and n=(ptr!=128). The exact integer identity -((128-ptr) mod 256)=q-256*n eliminates the offset subtractor. Each branch independently compresses address+b+q into carry-save form, resolves its low-byte carries with a parallel-prefix network, and constructs the upper bits directly. Control selects only completed branch results. Other parameter values retain the original RTL.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to shorten the arithmetic paths and leave control driving only the final result selection. No mapped candidate measurements are available, so an improvement over the 2.38 ns baseline is a prediction rather than a verified timing result.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses two parallel carry-save/prefix datapaths and a final result mux. Eliminating the offset subtractors and wide arithmetic should offset prefix-network overhead, but compliance with the 1311.632960 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations requires the specified mapping and STA flow; neither has been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves unsigned eight-bit ports and base parameter, the original modulo-256 offset semantics, modulo-65536 output behavior, and control=1 selecting ptr1. At base=128, the exact mathematical result lies in [-255,510], allowing ten-bit two's-complement computation followed by sign extension. All two-state inputs are covered without assumptions. Other base values use the original arithmetic and selection expressions. The design is combinational Verilog-2001 with no storage or external dependencies; mapped equivalence remains to be checked."
}
